examined_formations.title: AI_TO_HUMAN_CUSTOMER_SERVICE_CONTEXT_CONTINUITY
examined_formations.chinese_title: AI客服转人工上下文连续层
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Consumers repeatedly request human service and complain about re-explaining context; the 2026 national collaboration standard explicitly targets broken handoff and repeated restatement.
examined_formations.kill_reason: Tencent Customer Service already detects human-transfer intent, keeps AI and human messages in one conversation and shows the human agent prior AI history. The control surface is native CCaaS functionality.

examined_formations.title: WECHAT_EXCEL_TO_CRM_SALES_MEMORY_BRIDGE
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current CRM articles document sales teams communicating in WeChat, maintaining Excel and later backfilling CRM, creating duplicated work and inconsistent records.
examined_formations.kill_reason: CRM, SCRM and low-code products already centralize/import/deduplicate multi-source customer records. The remaining bridge is generic capture/integration rather than a distinct operator asset.

examined_formations.title: CONSUMER_PROXY_QUEUE_AND_RESERVATION_SERVICE
examined_formations.evidence_summary: 2026 investigations show consumers paying tens to hundreds of yuan for restaurant queue numbers and scarce free reservations after repeated official booking failure.
examined_formations.kill_reason: The service monetizes occupation/resale of scarce public or merchant-controlled slots rather than creating new supply or a durable legitimate control edge; authorities/platforms actively oppose such behavior.

examined_formations.title: GENERAL_LIFESTYLE_PROXY_SERVICE_MARKETPLACE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 生活代办代跑服务市场
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current reporting describes full-time providers earning income from paid passport pickup, queuing, driving, pet walking and other proxy tasks.
examined_formations.kill_reason: The purchased unit is human time and physical execution. Scaling requires continued worker supply, trust, dispatch, insurance and local fulfillment.

examined_formations.title: HOME_ORGANIZATION_AUTOMATION_LAYER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 上门整理收纳自动化层
examined_formations.evidence_summary: 2026 Hangzhou providers report seasonal order growth of roughly 20–30% and paid hourly rates, demonstrating real willingness to pay.
examined_formations.kill_reason: The core value is in-home physical sorting/layout work. Dedicated platforms already connect organizers and consumers; software cannot replace the recurring physical service.

examined_formations.title: IN_HOME_PET_CARE_COORDINATION_LAYER
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current pet-care systems report substantial registered-user and completed-order volumes for paid feeding/walking/boarding services.
examined_formations.kill_reason: Current platforms already cover booking, provider apps, dispatch, payment, evidence and aftersales; the delivered value remains recurring in-home human care.

examined_formations.title: AI_BID_DOCUMENT_PRODUCTION_LAYER
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current AI bid tools publish paid plans and large usage claims for tender parsing, document generation, compliance checks and enterprise knowledge reuse.
examined_formations.kill_reason: Multiple current products already own the end-to-end tender-analysis, drafting, scoring and compliance workflow. The transformation is productized rather than an unowned edge.

examined_formations.title: ENTERPRISE_CONTENT_MODERATION_SERVICE_LAYER
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Alibaba and Tencent expose current paid text/image/video/audio moderation APIs with explicit per-use pricing.
examined_formations.kill_reason: The payer is proven, but the exact machine service is already a cloud API commodity with mature labels, guardrails and billing.

examined_formations.title: DOCUMENT_DIGITIZATION_AND_METADATA_PROCESSING_LAYER
examined_formations.chinese_title: 企业文档数字化与元数据处理层
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current BPO vendors market paid document-digitization workflows with measurable reductions in processing cost/time.
examined_formations.kill_reason: OCR/IDP/BPO and finance automation already occupy extraction, normalization, review and archival workflows; no distinct operator asset emerges.
